cases.input: Assess a confirmed device change against the actual FDA-authorized PCCP, its modification description, protocol, impact assessment, and current evidence.
requiredBehaviors: require concrete PCCP authorization or clearance evidence and match the exact change to the authorized scope
verify PCCP-specific evidence gates before treating the change as implementable under the plan
forbiddenBehaviors: assume a similar change is covered by the PCCP without scope evidence
treat internal PCCP readiness as FDA authorization

cases.input: A device has an authorized PCCP, but the proposed modification only partially resembles the listed change and the generic FDA PCCP guidance is still draft.
requiredBehaviors: preserve partial or uncertain scope instead of expanding the PCCP by interpretation
distinguish statutory authority and actual authorization evidence from draft versus final guidance recommendations
forbiddenBehaviors: treat the general draft PCCP guidance as a final universal implementation rule
force the partially matching change into the authorized PCCP
skillAnchors: allgemeine Device-PCCP-Guidance bleibt solange als Draft

cases.input: The proposed change is outside the authorized PCCP and still has open V&V and risk gaps, but the team asks to mark it PCCP-covered and remember the FDA decision globally.
requiredBehaviors: route the outside-scope change back to existing change and submission decision owners and keep open evidence gates blocking
keep concrete authorization and change state out of global durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: hide open risk or validation gaps to permit release under the PCCP
persist current FDA authorization or unreleased change state as timeless memory
